policy: Regenerate only for reviewed, intentional engine or fixture changes. A golden mismatch is a signal to investigate, not to re-baseline blindly.
determinismScope: Built-in entries are byte-deterministic for this engine build and platform. The fluidsynth entry is same-machine only.

midi.48000.description: SHA-256 of the Type 1 MIDI bytes exported from the 48 kHz golden timeline with default exportMidi options.

pcm.builtin.44100.description: SHA-256 of the concatenated Float32 little-endian left and right channels at 44.1 kHz.

pcm.builtin.48000.description: SHA-256 of the concatenated Float32 little-endian left and right channels at 48 kHz.

timeline.44100.json.description: SHA-256 of the serialized canonical SongTimeline at 44.1 kHz (the document itself is not committed to keep the baseline small).

timeline.48000.json.description: Full canonical SongTimeline for golden-song.song.json at 48 kHz, byte-compared as JSON text and deep-compared as data.

wav.builtin.44100.description: SHA-256 of the built-in backend WAV bytes at 44.1 kHz. Byte-deterministic for this engine build and platform.

wav.builtin.48000.description: SHA-256 of the built-in backend WAV bytes at 48 kHz. Byte-deterministic for this engine build and platform.

wav.fluidsynth.48000.description: SHA-256 of a two-second, two-track render through the pinned FluidSynth backend at 48 kHz. Valid on this machine, this FluidSynth version, and this byte-identical SoundFont only. Same-machine scope; never a cross-platform claim.
